No surprises to the Exec. No escalations arriving at the CEO s desk that should have been resolved two levels down. The bar we re setting: your deputies own outcomes, not tasks. Join us on our mission to make a better world of work. Culture Amp is backed by leading venture capital funds and has offices in the US, UK, Germany and Australia. Culture Amp has been recognized as one of the world’s top private cloud companies by Forbes and most innovative companies by Fast Company. For more information visit cultureamp.com . We are seeking an experienced Regional Marketing Director to lead marketing for North America, our largest region. This is a senior leadership role, responsible for building and executing a data-driven regional strategy that drives new customer acquisition, expands our existing customer base, and strengthens Culture Amp s brand across the region. The role sits within our Growth Marketing team and reports to the VP of Growth Marketing. This role can be based in our Chicago, Austin, or New York hubs. A willingness to travel as required to support regional events and initiatives is a must! What you will do: Regional strategy: Develop and execute a data-driven North America marketing strategy that drives new customer acquisition, expands the existing customer base, and supports the region s growth targets. Sales and CX alignment: Align the North America marketing strategy with the region s sales and customer experience (CX) strategy, ensuring pipeline generation and customer experience move together. Sales and SDR partnership: Build and maintain close partnerships with sales leadership, sellers, SDR leadership and SDRs. This partnership is critical to achieving pipeline and growth targets across the region. Team leadership and development: Lead, mentor and develop a high-performing North America marketing team, building a culture of collaboration, accountability and excellence. AI-driven execution: Identify where AI tools can accelerate campaign delivery, content production and reporting, and embed them into the team s ways of working. AI fluency and change management: Build the team s fluency with AI tools and lead the change management required to adopt new AI-enabled workflows. Collaboration with the Growth Marketing team: Partner with your fellow leaders in the Growth marketing team, which includes demand generation, ABM, the website, lifecycle marketing, SDR and regional leaders from EMEA and APAC, to bring global programmes to life in North America and represent the region s priorities back to the global team. Alignment with global marketing: Partner with the broader global marketing organisation, which owns brand, comms, PR, social, and solutions marketing,. Event strategy: Own the strategy and execution of regional events, trade shows and webinars, creating brand experiences that generate high-quality leads. Budget optimisation: Manage the North America marketing budget, optimising the allocation of resources and investing where it will generate the best return. jobs.title: Senior People Science Analyst (12 month FTC)
jobs.desc: We’re big believers in the power of IRL, so for most roles we ask Campers to work from their local Culture Amp office an average of 2 days a week to unlock connection, pace and culture together. Join us on our mission to make a better world of work. Culture Amp is the world’s leading employee experience platform, revolutionizing how 25 million employees across more than 6,000 companies create a better world of work. Culture Amp empowers companies of all sizes and industries to transform employee engagement, drive performance management, and develop high-performing teams. Powered by people science and the most comprehensive employee dataset in the world, the most innovative companies including Canva, On, Asana, Dolby, McDonalds and Nasdaq depend on Culture Amp every day. Culture Amp is backed by leading venture capital funds and has offices in the US, UK, Germany and Australia. Culture Amp has been recognized as one of the world’s top private cloud companies by Forbes and most innovative companies by Fast Company. For more information visit cultureamp.com . We re looking for a Senior People Science Analyst to join our global People Science Analytics team on a 12-month fixed term contract. You ll specifically partner with customers across EMEA and North America on bespoke research using Culture Amp and customer-supplied data, owning studies from question through to action. GenAI tools will be part of that workflow, helping you work more efficiently, as you continue to identify further areas for improvement. As a thought leader in HR analytics, you ll combine data across diverse customers and use methods from psychology, economics and business to generate advanced insights into how employee experience shapes outcomes like turnover, sales performance and customer satisfaction. You ll surface trends for the HR community and make complex findings accessible through clear, engaging stories and practical strategies. The work is technical and customer-facing. You ll listen closely to customers, bring clarity to methodology and reporting, and collaborate with HR leaders, customer-facing People Scientists, Customer Success Managers and Account Managers to develop studies and insight reports for clients and the wider public. You ll also help customers and colleagues build confidence with data. Because the team is small and the projects are complex, you ll have real ownership over which questions are worth answering and how they get answered. As part of this team of amazing humans, You will: Lead customer discovery and own studies end to end, from clarifying the business problem and shaping the research question through to design, delivery and recommendations Design, clean, combine and explore platform and customer-supplied datasets using robust, reusable approaches that protect participant privacy Conduct rigorous statistical analyses across engagement, lifecycle, performance and team effectiveness data, generating actionable and, where appropriate, predictive insights tied to business outcomes Use AI tools to accelerate research, analysis, synthesis and communication, while validating outputs, protecting customer data and maintaining methodological rigour Collaborate with customer-facing People Scientists on advanced HR analytics projects, applying sound judgment about methods, limitations and trade-offs Identify the themes and stories most likely to help organisations improve their culture and business outcomes, then communicate them through clear reports, presentations and internal and external thought leadership Create reusable methods, templates and assets; improve internal processes and practices; and negotiate scope, priorities and timelines to deliver high-quality work You have: An advanced degree (Masters or PhD) in organisational psychology, quantitative social science, economics or a related field, or equivalent applied research experience Applied experience using quantitative research methods on people or workforce data, ideal

The Senior Account-Based Marketing Manager’s mission is to strategically lead and scale Culture Amp’s multi-tiered ABM strategies. Working collaboratively across marketing, SDR, RevOps/MOPs, you will architect, execute, and optimize full-funnel demand generation programs that move the needle on revenue. The ideal candidate is an expert B2B growth marketer who operates with a high degree of autonomy and possesses strong experience scaling global ABM programs. As a senior leader within the Global Demand Generation team,you will design and champion our overarching ABM programs. You will own the strategic deployment of 1:few (industry and cohort-aligned), and 1:many (scaled, always-on) ABM programs spanning paid, owned, and earned channels. This role is responsible for the ongoing optimization and account research via the 6sense platform, and will partner closely with Global Regional leadership to drive high-value New Logo acquisition and support Expansion (Customer) cross-sell motions. Responsibilities: Define, develop, and lead the overarching ABM program for the global upper Commercial Enterprise segments, ensuring a consistent, personalized experience across channels to accelerate pipeline and growth. Architect and execute multi-tiered ABM strategies, including targeted 1:Few plays for top-tier accounts, 1:few industry-specific vertical campaigns, and programmatic 1:many campaigns for broader market capture. Serve as the global super-user and strategic marketing owner of the 6sense platform; govern data-driven segment building, mature intent keyword architecture, and automated orchestration playbooks. Partner closely with Sales and Regional Marketing Leads to establish deep feedback loops, aligning ABM programs with localized sales goals while maintaining a unified global strategy. Establish measurement frameworks and campaign metrics alongside marketing analytics teams Oversee the collaborative creation of bespoke content and high-impact messaging tailored to specific target account lists, industries, and/or executive personas across email, executive events, paid media, and conversational marketing. Conduct market, industry, and account-level research to uncover unmet needs, pain points, and buying triggers, translating these insights into actionable ABM playbooks. What You Bring to Our Camp Skills and Qualifications: Proven track record of designing, building, and scaling comprehensive 1:few, and 1:many ABM programs that measurably drive net-new ARR and customer expansion in the SaaS/B2B technology space. 6+ years of marketing experience, with a heavy emphasis on demand generation, enterprise campaigns, or vertical marketing. 3+ years of dedicated Account-Based Marketing experience in a B2B SaaS environment. A sophisticated global mindset with the ability to navigate cross-cultural nuances, manage international stakeholder relationships, and localize broad strategies effec

Observability: Design monitoring, alerting and safe remediation workflows for critical services, using automation and AI-assisted operations where appropriate and properly governed. Escalation support: Provide senior escalation support for complex infrastructure and workplace technology incidents, driving root-cause analysis, remediation and preventative improvements.
